notes.title: Get Packed: Fully Loaded Preview Stream
notes.content:
We are excited to not only announce that Get Packed: Fully Loaded is coming to Steam on July 29th but as part of Steam Next Fest you can jump in early and play the demo. Become the mover you have always wanted to be and try not blow everything up...??

Download and play the Demo now until June 22nd!!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

To celebrate the release date announcement, as well as Steam Next Fest, we are doing a preview livestream. Join Kal & a host of friends playing through some of the new levels included within Get Packed: Fully Loaded

Playing some of the new levels included in the new Fully Loaded version, your first look at the new places you can [strike]create havoc[/strike] move furniture in a completely normal way.

We will also be giving away some Get Packed themed 'Bliss the Cat' shirts during the stream. You do not want to miss your chance at these exclusives. 

We look forward to seeing you there, get ready to Get Packed!
